aggregate_accounting.spend_note: This is canary/transport-validation spend, NOT experiment spend. High input-token totals reflect the multi-turn loop re-sending the growing conversation each turn (packet ~8.2K but conversation accumulates search results across up to 12 turns; 'inputTokens' here is the sum over turns, so it counts re-sent context repeatedly).

new_non_transport_observation.issue: 2 of 3 fixtures exhausted MAX_TOOL_TURNS=12 with only search_hypotheses calls and never emitted submit_selections; the runner correctly returned LLM_STATE_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed, no fabrication).
new_non_transport_observation.classification: NOT a transport failure. It is a research-loop turn-budget / model-behavior interaction.
new_non_transport_observation.why_not_fixed_here: Raising MAX_TOOL_TURNS or nudging the prompt to submit earlier would be apparatus/prompt/behavior tuning done AFTER observing fixture behavior, which the transport-only mandate (and the no-mid-run-tuning rule) forbids. MAX_TOOL_TURNS lives in the transport module but changing it in response to observed selection behavior is outcome-adjacent and must be an explicit, separately-authorized decision, not a silent transport tweak.
new_non_transport_observation.input_token_cost_implication: The multi-turn loop re-sends the full accumulated conversation each turn; a fixture that runs many search turns accumulates large input-token usage (542K on the worst fixture). Relevant to the 1000-fixture run economics and to the MAX_TOOL_TURNS decision.
options_for_user_decision: A) Accept current behavior: fixtures that never submit are recorded as INVALID/UNAVAILABLE in the eventual attrition ledger; this is a legitimate outcome-blind attrition category if frozen BEFORE the experiment.
B) Adjust MAX_TOOL_TURNS as an explicit, pre-registered transport/runtime parameter (frozen before experiment, justified independently of any football content).
C) Any prompt-level change to encourage timely submission — NOT permitted under the current mandate; would require re-opening the frozen research protocol under a new authorization.

canary_success_criteria_ss9.overall: TRANSPORT_CRITERIA_ALL_MET; but 2/3 fixtures did not reach submit_selections due to a NON-TRANSPORT turn-budget/behavior interaction — reported, not tuned.
